camel_example: aliyun csas UpdatePrivateAccessApplicationL7Switch --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --TimeoutSec 60 --DevTagMarkStatus Disabled --PortRanges.1.Begin 80 --ZeroTrustStatus Enabled --SrcIpMarkStatus Disabled --PortRanges.1.End 81 --ApplicationId 'pa-application-e12860ef6c48****' --UserMarkStatus Enabled --DownloadAuditStatus Disabled --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the Layer 7 access switch for an internal access application
description_zh: 更新内网访问应用七层开关
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-private-access-application-l7-switch --application-id 'pa-application-e12860ef6c48****' --status Enabled --zero-trust-status Enabled --user-mark-status Enabled --download-audit-status Disabled --src-ip-mark-status Disabled --dev-tag-mark-status Disabled --timeout-sec 60 --port-ranges Begin=80 End=81 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrivateAccessApplicationL7Switch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the internal access application. Required
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en:
The master switch for the Layer 7 access switch of the internal access application. Required. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.

When the value is set to Disabled, PortRanges is neither verified nor saved
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用七层访问开关的总开关。必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭。

取值为 Disabled 时不校验也不保存 PortRanges
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The Host bypass prevention switch. Required. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Host防绕过开关。必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: zero_trust_status

parameters.help_en:
The user marking switch. Required. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
用户标记开关。必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: user_mark_status

parameters.help_en:
The download audit switch for sensitive applications. Optional. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
敏感应用下载审计开关。非必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: download_audit_status

parameters.help_en:
The source IP marking switch. Required. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
源IP标记开关。必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: src_ip_mark_status

parameters.help_en:
The device tag marking switch. Required. Valid values:

Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备标签标记开关。必填。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: dev_tag_mark_status

parameters.help_en: The request timeout period, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 60. If this parameter is not specified or an invalid value is specified, the default value 60 is used
parameters.help_zh: 请求超时时长，单位为秒。取值范围：1~3600。默认值为60。未传入或取值非法时按60处理
parameters.name: timeout_sec

fields.help_en: The start port. The value must be less than or equal to the end port
fields.help_zh: 起始端口。小于等于结束端口
fields.name: begin

fields.help_en: The end port. The value must be greater than or equal to the start port
fields.help_zh: 结束端口。大于等于起始端口
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The port ranges for the internal access application. Multiple port ranges cannot overlap or be duplicated. You can specify up to 50 port ranges. This parameter takes effect and is verified only when Status is set to Enabled. If this parameter is not specified or an empty set is specified, the default ports 80, 443, 8080, and 465 are used. The effective ports are the intersection of the ports specified in this request and the configured port ranges of the internal access application
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用端口范围集合。多个端口范围不可重复或重叠。最多可输入50个端口范围。仅当 Status 取值为 Enabled 时生效并校验：此时未传入或传入空集合，按默认端口80、443、8080、465处理；最终生效的端口为本次传入端口与该内网访问应用已配置端口范围的交集
parameters.name: port_ranges
